mesh.terrain_build_note: 2026-08 third pass at 10M: 195 basins cut and 40 notched out of the 4657 carve1 left standing, ice from carve1's baseline freezing height, --glacial 0.3, basin floor 850

method: Area-weighted land fraction per cell from the native mesh, thresholded; topography is the land-area-weighted mean elevation over land regions only.

candidate_rules.why: a threshold is a DECISION and cannot be taken against one rule's cost alone; these are the alternatives priced in the same terms. Nothing here changes what this builder writes.

coastline_ledger.why: the model's mask is binary at oceanmod.f90:256 whatever this builder writes; this is the size of the rounding, in both signs, not a proposal to change it

operators.elevation: gridding.cell_mean over the land population, INTENSIVE, via gridding.land_weighted

medium.note: The lived rhythm. Damped about 0.83, so amplitude times damping times `lib/sensitivity.py`'s slope, some thirty times Earth's solar-cycle signal and the dominant climatic fact of any individual life. Fast enough to be planned around, too fast for ice to follow. The kelvin figure is NOT restated here: it is a product of a slope that is re-derived per model, and the two numbers that stood here before reproduced at a slope retired two measurements ago.

long.note: The geomorphic driver. Essentially undamped at 0.99, so amplitude times damping times the same slope, slow enough that glaciers equilibrate rather than merely breathing. Each grand minimum is a distinct historical era.
